"Onslaught of the Star Breakers":
"Onslaught of the Star Breakers is a difficult Solo Quest, in which your objective is to defeat powerful enemies.

Clearing a Stage unlocks the next Stage."

"During the Quest, effects that strengthen the enemy or weaken the player may be applied, depending on the Rank.

The specific effects that will be applied to the Quest will be shown before accepting it, and can be viewed on the Main Menu after the Quest has been accepted."
